cards.name: 乐魂
cards.title: 炽云乐游
cards.description: 珍珠云海与琥珀星火，托起轻盈自在的乐魂。
cards.quote: 轻轻飘，也能飘向很远的星光。
cards.backgroundBrief: Pearl-white celestial cloud terraces at sunset, amber stars, suspended ivory cubes and slender golden constellation paths, warm cream and midnight amber contrast. Elaborate gilt cloud-scroll border with tiny inlaid gems.

cards.name: 月薪猫
cards.title: 月色摸鱼
cards.description: 月下云台、薄荷微风与一只自在的小猫。
cards.quote: 认真生活，也别忘了给自己一点轻松。
cards.backgroundBrief: Mint-turquoise night sky, luminous crescent moon, drifting ribbon clouds, tiny distant rooftops, suspended golden terrace. Elegant whimsical gilt moon-and-cloud border, restrained iridescent blue jade filigree.

cards.name: 线条小狗
cards.title: 星光抱抱
cards.description: 奶油云朵与细碎星光，收藏一个暖暖的抱抱。
cards.quote: 今天已经很棒啦，抱抱再出发。
cards.backgroundBrief: Dreamlike cream and pale peach clouds, tiny gold stars, faraway celestial pavilion and a softly glowing cloud cushion below center. Highly crafted pale-gold ribbon-and-star border with pearl inlay. Cute but sophisticated, not a nursery clipart poster.

cards.name: 张起灵（Q）
cards.title: 玄门听雨
cards.description: 青铜玄门、山间细雨与安静坚定的守望。
cards.quote: 不必急着回答，路会慢慢清晰。
cards.backgroundBrief: Misty turquoise mountain canyon and an ancient bronze ceremonial doorway at distant center, fine rain, jade river reflections, subtle geometric bronze ornament. Delicate engraved bronze-and-gold archaeological border, teal inlay. Mystical but not horror, no skulls.

cards.name: 夺舍红狼
cards.title: 玄岩赤瞳
cards.description: 黑曜金甲与赤色辉光，凝成沉着强大的锋芒。
cards.quote: 把锋芒藏好，让实力替你发光。
cards.backgroundBrief: Obsidian sci-fi temple, deeply engraved black stone platforms, bronze mechanical arcs and controlled ruby energy behind center. Architectural golden geometry, red gems only on outer border and lower corners. Dramatic black-gold collectible luxury, no combat, no gore.

cards.name: 威虫
cards.title: 琥珀巡航
cards.description: 琥珀机库与湛蓝微光，为小小巡航员点亮航线。
cards.quote: 每一次起飞，都从小小的勇气开始。
cards.backgroundBrief: Deep blue and amber futuristic airship hangar, distant tiny airships, warm hexagonal glass windows, a floating gold-rim launch platform below center. Ornate brass aviator border, engraved gear filigree and tiny amber lenses. Friendly adventurous feeling.

cards.name: 皮皮
cards.title: 天禄踏云
cards.description: 青蓝流云与鎏金瑞纹，陪皮皮踏上新的旅程。
cards.quote: 就算忘了来路，也能走出新的故事。
cards.backgroundBrief: Turquoise Chinese celestial gardens, curved cloud bridges, lotus pool reflected moonlight, pale jade ornaments and gold curling cloud motifs. Elaborate auspicious cloud-and-lotus gilt border with turquoise enamel. Cute elegant storybook magic.

cards.name: 电能豌豆射手
cards.title: 棱光蓄能
cards.description: 翡翠叶台与棱镜电光，让小小能量闪闪发亮。
cards.quote: 把能量攒好，下一次就会更耀眼。
cards.backgroundBrief: Emerald crystal greenhouse observatory, luminous pale-green energy conduits, delicate golden lattice, emerald leaf altar near lower center. Engraved gold and mint crystalline border, small prism lightning ornaments at corners. No blasts toward viewer, no combat or targets.

cards.name: 银狼
cards.title: 像素破界
cards.description: 蓝紫像素与银色星网，收藏一场轻巧的破界冒险。
cards.quote: 换个思路，下一关也许就通了。
cards.backgroundBrief: Blue-violet cyberpunk dream city with softly glowing pixel cubes, silver network arcs and distant neon glass towers. Premium silver-gold circuit filigree card border, violet and cyan gemstone corners, tiny pixel particles at edges. No readable computer text or brand logos.
